scope: Read-only adversarial review of dissent.py authorization warnings and ledger validation
Read-only review of core.py scoped negation and audit.py retention boundary
Adversarial review of cognition.py temporal views, type boundary, goal persistence and stop
Read-only review of integration.py critical_review wrapper and its five existing tests

findings.first_observation: Standalone reproduction: append A at epoch1 and B at epoch2; assess at2 then at1. Historical assess returned revised=true, previous_decision=B, decision=A, revision_reason=new_observed_evidence and inserted a new live view despite no new event.
findings.fix: Record as_of frontier; older queries return historical_query=true and revised=false without rewriting current belief. An unchanged later assessment advances the frontier.

findings.first_observation: An arbitrary object exposing evidence() returned reused Evidence with private string IDs. append returned new and SQLite dump contained the synthetic canary. First retained test failed.
findings.fix: Require exact EvidenceEvent before converting validated numeric fields.

findings.first_observation: A caller-built dataclass with benefit_weight, effort_weight and an extra synthetic private field name was accepted and persisted. First retained test failed.
findings.fix: Require exact PreferenceProfile and GoalOption types and tuple container before serialization.

findings.first_observation: Standalone reproduction showed stop=True with empty options rejected before stop could be recorded.
findings.fix: Allow empty candidates for stop; keep halted state across checkpoint recovery.

findings.first_observation: Early adapter instantiated GoalMemory but replaced persistence with custom save/load.
findings.fix: Current adapter calls original GoalMemory.save/load. Recomputed Git blob SHA1 for both reused modules matches pinned source.

findings.first_observation: Early output contained source-root IDs without exact event IDs.
findings.fix: Current assess output includes supporting_event_ids and opposing_event_ids.

wrapper_review.observed: Malformed dissent signals are validated before memory mutation; supporting evidence cannot remove external-action halt; contradiction causes source-independent provisional dissent; conflict/missing evidence abstains; execution_permitted remains false.

limitations: A separate AI agent is not an independent human evaluator.
The reviewer did not inspect or execute the reserved heldout evaluator.
The same-information simple reducer can match the candidate by construction; categorical performance is not generalized reasoning or consciousness evidence.
Latest-epoch precedence and source trust labels remain authored synthetic policies.
Integrity anchors detect changed data only if the separate anchor remains trusted; coordinated data and anchor replacement is outside the protection.
No real source authentication, authorization verifier or external-action executor exists.
Goal planner supports stop and reconsideration but has no dedicated trusted authorization-revocation control.
Unknown or indirect negation/metaphor cases remain outside the bounded creative correction.
Passing these checks is not a complete security audit or production readiness claim.
